newsitem.title: UK: Assoc. British Ports plans Ipswich terminal.
newsitem.headline: Assoc. British Ports plans Ipswich terminal.

text.p: Associated British Ports Holdings Plc today announced its first major investment in the Port of Ipswich.
ABP Ipswich and Sentinel Shipping Services, which is part of the Genchem Group, have agreed to construct a new 1.5 million sterling agricultural bulk terminal, it said.
The UK ports group acquired Ipswich Port on March 25, 1997.

The terminal, which will completed by the next harvest, will be located alongside deep water berths on the east bank of the River Orwell, ABP said. It will comprise a 90,000 square foot covered store for cereals and animal feeds plus foundations for a silo complex to be built at a later date.
